result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software depends heavily on where your business operates. If you're running a small business in Australia, I'd shortlist **Xero, MYOB, Employment Hero, and Reckon** rather than US-focused platforms such as Gusto or ADP.

For most Australian small businesses, my starting recommendation would be **Xero Payroll** if you also want accounting in the same system, or **MYOB** if you want a straightforward payroll-focused solution.

## Best options in Australia

| Software | Best for | My assessment |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Xero Payroll | Small businesses already using Xero | Best all-round choice |
| MYOB | Small teams and accounting integration | Strong alternative |
| Employment Hero | Award rates, casuals and rostering | Best for complex wages |
| Reckon Payroll | Budget-conscious small businesses | Good value |
| Payroller | Micro businesses with 1–4 employees | Simple and affordable |


### My top three

![Xero – AccountKit Support Center](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/HOFZdHQfaXHdQ0Jl6FhQm1ZL8WDa2JXXY2s_IDNQw6_ClmY--iV2XW1k6Glaj1ICzU7IfOAztiKsPODuDYTSIw6PRmUslgzmZ5aMlPuGROKkGMtSJzGnCUzu5B8zEx6lZO3rd6Y_GILZvoN2_MXkKzeqqLSGOUSO0lv-UiE7fZFfvbCSDizWo5sdMixvhee4?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero Payroll**

(Best overall)

- Payroll integrated with accounting.
- STP reporting and superannuation.
- Good bookkeeping workflow.
- Payroll included in eligible Australian plans, with employee limits depending on the plan.

Website: [Xero Australia](https://www.xero.com/au/)\.

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

- Good for small businesses wanting payroll and accounting together.
- Standalone payroll option for very small teams.
- Handles Australian payroll reporting.

Website: [MYOB Australia](https://www.myob.com/au)\.

---

![Employment Hero - Which HR Software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hoOMaIHHE1BVK8wWyswfFUWF-4zNLm2VTTf8I0IsZi71QvwwVg013JN6PZd_JzmKlLo5GMH1Nn9Dlq8Awe3_MYWQTya_RX2YJlpU2kxq0LmTpktkVrYam4C6Jqjid1iaOedcQ7rhD-uZbRDBcKqCEBszhJOC_eRUB4bTTF7gnOKcGZ7dKIuzDzdg-ruuRgJy?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Employment Hero**

- Particularly useful for casual and hourly employees.
- Modern Award interpretation.
- Rostering, timesheets and HR features.

Website: [Employment Hero Australia](https://employmenthero.com/au/)\.

## Important Australian payroll requirements

Whichever platform you choose, check that it supports\:

- Single Touch Payroll (STP) Phase 2.
- PAYG tax withholding.
- Superannuation payments.
- Payday Super requirements, effective 1 July 2026.
- Annual leave, personal leave and termination calculations.
- Modern Award rates, overtime and penalty rates where applicable.

These are particularly important if you employ casual or shift workers. [australiansmallbusiness.com.au](https://australiansmallbusiness.com.au/software/best-payroll-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[awts.net.au](https://awts.net.au/blog/best-payroll-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I would narrow it down based on how your business operates rather than simply choosing the cheapest software.

**Can I ask two quick questions?**

1. How many employees do you have (or expect to have)?
2. What type of business do you run?

For example, retail, hospitality, construction, trades, professional services or something else.

With those two details, I can recommend the best option, compare actual Australian monthly costs and identify which will make payroll easiest to manage.

search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
